data.one_liner: A Dart library for mathematical programming, complex numbers, algebra, statistics, and geometry.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for complex numbers, advanced linear algebra, matrix operations, statistics, geometry, code translation (Morse and number-to-words), symbolic calculus, and equation solving.
use_when: You need complex mathematical computations, linear algebra, or matrix decompositions.
You want to perform symbolic calculus, polynomial factoring, or Laplace transforms.
You need statistics, geometry, or custom angle operations in Dart.
avoid_when: You only need basic arithmetic where standard Dart operators suffice.
You require heavy mathematical computing where a native C/C++ binding wrapper might perform better.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set covering algebra, geometry, statistics, and symbolic calculus.
Supports multiple matrix decomposition and linear system solving methods.
Includes utilities like Morse code and number-to-words translation.
weaknesses: Large feature scope may be overkill for simple applications.
Performance on very large matrices might not match specialized native libraries.
